 World Languages
Implementation Timeline
The implementation of the NYS Learning Standards for World Languages was purposely designed to
be gradual, with a two-year pre-implementation period, then a gradual implementation process
divided into three phrases:
Phase I:  Raising Awareness and Building Capacity (2021-August 2023) - Roll-out and building
awareness of the revised standards and timeline for implementation; professional learning
opportunities to prepare schools to transition to the revised standards
Phase II:  Gradual Implementation and Building Capacity (September 2023 – August 2028) -
Focus on professional learning, resource acquisition, curriculum alignment, and assessment
alignment
Phase III:  Full Implementation and Sustainability (September 2028 and on) - All K-12 World
Language courses will be aligned with NYS Learning Standards for World Languages
Districts with secondary (middle and high school) world language programs may implement the
revised NYS Learning Standards for World Languages (2021) as early as they would like, however, all
districts must implement these revised standards by no later than indicated by the following
schedule:

Districts with elementary world language programs will implement he revised standards starting with
the first year world language is offered as of September  2023.  In each subsequent year, the revised
standards will be implemented (course curricula and instruction aligned to the revised standards) in
the next grade level in which world languages is offered, and so forth, and so on, until the
revised standards are implemented in all grade levels K-12 no later than September 1, 2028.
